findingClass: a source record bound to the wrong IPO row or left un-superseded (OD-85): one IPO holding two ACTIVE record numbers of the same source (a relaunch whose OD-83 supersede never happened, or a merge that joined two relaunch numbers), or a key the CIN/ISIN re-check marked DISPUTED - a wrong bind whose written values need recomputing
failThreshold: any ipos row with more than one ACTIVE ipo_source_keys row of the same (source, key_type), or any ipo_source_keys row whose state became DISPUTED in the last 30 days
unverifiableWhen: ipo_source_keys unreadable for a reason other than the table not existing yet (42P01 before migration 0053 = PASS)
note: OD-85 / OD-86, F-144..F-149. Keys hitting two different rows cannot be stored (plain UNIQUE(source, key_type, binding_value)); a record whose keys hit two rows is refused at read time and logged as source_key_duplicate. This check reads what the table CAN hold wrongly.
